evidence_limits: The primary pass proves the already-built Debug B03 fixture boots directory 2/stage 103 with the generated ABI-v3 profile, canonical authored state, valid initial projection, real-pad replays, and deterministic two-session parity.
Node destruction is accepted only when all three owner-tagged echo projectiles are observed immediately before their exact 3-to-2-to-1-to-0 health transitions in both parity sessions.

Gate traversal is accepted only when the current actor is observed blocked at x=156 while vertically overlapping the closed 16x32 leaf, then inside and fully east of that same leaf while its live state is open.
The completion claim additionally requires the final B edge to come from physical current-actor slot 6 and target B03_COMMIT.
The separate zero-echo run proves merely reaching B03_COMMIT and making a one-step B attempt cannot begin the locked hold or satisfy completion value $1007.

The positive route completes at tick 292 after a proven 20-step uninterrupted current-only B hold and does not exercise B03_SHUTTER_FIELD's later warning, closing, or damage tail; no claim about those transitions is made here.
No visual, audio, performance, PAL, save, Release-ROM, or full campaign claim is made.
